name: CoWoS advanced packaging
thesis: The gate on every advanced AI accelerator shipped — if a chip needs HBM, it needs CoWoS, and capacity is effectively sold out.

gauge.rationale: Tightness rose as CoWoS-L demand outran 2026 capacity adds; gap not expected to close until 2027.

why_it_gates: CoWoS bonds the GPU die to its HBM stacks on a silicon interposer. No interposer, no high-bandwidth memory, no usable accelerator. Because nearly all leading-edge capacity sits with one supplier, each hyperscaler's GPU allocation is rationed by how many packaging slots it can secure — making this the true rate-limiter on AI compute, upstream of the chips themselves.

watchlist.name: TSMC
watchlist.role: Owns the bulk of CoWoS capacity

catalysts.text: New TSMC packaging fabs (Chiayi AP7, Tainan AP8) reach volume output
SoIC + CoWoS hybrid lines scale for next-gen accelerators
Capacity targeted to ~170k wafers/mo; glass-substrate pilots could relieve interposer scarcity

what_loosens_it: Faster-than-guided capacity from ASE and Amkor, a demand air-pocket if GPU orders soften, or a shift to panel-level / glass substrates that sidesteps silicon-interposer scarcity. None look likely to bite before late 2026.

developments.text: Institutional investors revise TSMC's end-2026 CoWoS capacity forecast up 14% to ~125k wpm
Nvidia secures ~60% of 2026 CoWoS capacity (~595k wafers)
Analysis: even with $56B 2026 capex, supply-demand gap won't fully close until 2027
